title: Le Mod Wenjah
description: A mod about a really entertaining Youtuber (Wenjah) That adds really cool features (armor,tools,music) And new game mechanics!
body:
Its a mod about a youtuber know as Wenjah , there will be armor weapons and other features added that reference something that Wenjah did in his youtube career.


What Our Mod Adds?


It adds alot of stuff !

-New dimension Sky dimension : where you can find floating sky block islands where u can get a new material The Sky Ore!

-Sky ingot with that ingot you can craft a whole set of sky armor which is really tuff (stronger than netherite)

-Sky Armor

-Sky Sword A really strong sword made from sky ingot

-Wenjah Ore another new ore made by 1 sky ingot and 1 ''Wenjah DNA'' 

-Wenjah DNA can be obtained by killing ''Wenjah Mobs''

-Wenjah Sword The most strogest sword in the whole game

-Baguette Wenjah This can be made by 1 wenjah ingot and 1 bread and its an infinite Bread!

-New Cool Music (Actually 2 Music Discs New Ost Soon ..)


Why Should You Download Our Mod?

Our mod adds alot of armor and swords and really strong bosses and really cool music so if you like any of those you should check it ;)


IMPORTANT NOTE:

Any of those features Might be deleted in the future the mod is in its alpha phase so some feature will get deleted
